title: Two-level size cap (Content-Length header + actual bytes) is correct
description: All HTTP response readers (fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob) first check Content-Length (early exit) then re-check after actual read. Content-Length lying is a documented attack vector (chunked encoding, misconfigured proxies). The two-level check is correct. A future contributor might remove the second check as 'redundant' — it is not.
